// PROBE FIXTURE — the Supabase cookie adapter exactly as proxy.ts shipped it to
// production, extracted from 12deab09 before it was replaced. Committed rather
// than read from git history: CI checks out shallow, so a probe that reaches for
// an old commit passes locally and fails in CI. Kept as .txt so the guard's own
// filesystem sweep for *.ts client files cannot pick it up as a live offender.
//
// tests/unit/supabase-cookie-adapter-single-shape.test.ts asserts the detector
// reddens on this. If it ever stops doing so, the guard has gone blind.

    const supabase = createServerClient(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
        {
            cookies: {
                get(name: string) {
                    return request.cookies.get(name)?.value
                },
                set(name: string, value: string, options: any) {
                    request.cookies.set({
                        name,
                        value,
                        ...options,
                    })
                    response = NextResponse.next({
                        request: {
                            headers: request.headers,
                        },
                    })
                    response.cookies.set({
                        name,
                        value,
                        ...options,
                    })
                },
                remove(name: string, options: any) {
                    request.cookies.set({
                        name,
                        value: "",
                        ...options,
                    })
                    response = NextResponse.next({
                        request: {
                            headers: request.headers,
                        },
                    })
                    response.cookies.set({
                        name,
                        value: "",
                        ...options,
                    })
                },
            },
        }
    )
